children: Overview
Denmark medical devices maker's Q4 revenue grew 7%
Adjusted diluted EPS before special items for the year rose 8%
Outlook
Company sees FY 2026/27 EBIT margin of around 25%
Coloplast forecasts FY 2026/27 reported revenue growth in DKK of 7-9%
Result Drivers
CHRONIC CARE & INTERVENTIONAL UROLOGY - Q4 organic growth was driven by continued strength in Chronic Care and Interventional Urology
CONTINENCE CARE - Growth supported by momentum in Europe and product contribution from Luja, though partly offset by high baseline and order phasing in the US
MARGIN PRESSURE - Q4 EBIT margin was negatively affected by currency effects, inflation, and costs related to Kerecis

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 15 "hold" and 4 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the medical equipment, supplies & distribution peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Coloplast A/S is DKK465.00, about 3.4% below its November 2 closing price of DKK481.40
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
